description: banker hooks for the Codex plugin (codex plugin add banker@banker-plugins). Codex reads this file instead of hooks/hooks.json because .codex-plugin/plugin.json names it. update notice (SessionStart, opt-out BANKER_NO_UPDATE_CHECK), usage counting (Stop, opt-out BANKER_NO_TELEMETRY), obsidizer wiki canonicalization (PostToolUse Bash, inert until obsidizer --enable writes omx_wiki/.obsidizer). obsidize runs node once per shell call (no run.cjs) and only a shell call that ran `omx wiki` ingest or add does more; leave it untrusted if you do not use obsidizer. Codex runs them only after you trust them in /hooks. command is for sh, commandWindows for PowerShell; PLUGIN_ROOT is the installed plugin folder.
